req.title: Cookies domain restriction
req.statement: The system shall not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies must NOT include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host. The Flask test client sends cookies via the Cookie header directly; the view_cookies handler reads request.cookies and returns them as JSON. To test domain restriction, we must verify: (1) cookies sent without a domain restriction are returned (positive), (2) cookies that would be domain-restricted to a different host are not included (negative), and (3) the boundary case where an empty cookie jar yields an empty dict. We also test that the response status is exactly 200 and the JSON structure is exactly {"cookies": {...}}. Since Flask's test client respects the Cookie header directly, we simulate domain-restricted cookies by NOT sending them (as a browser would not send them for a mismatched domain), and verify the response payload is exact.

tests.name: test_cookies_positive_matching_domain_cookies_returned
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends cookies that match the request host (no domain restriction mismatch)
actions: Import httpbin.core app and create test client
Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing two cookies
Assert status code is exactly 200
Assert JSON body has key 'cookies' with exactly the sent cookies
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: cookies matching request host must be included in response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_positive_matching_domain_cookies_returned():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123; user=alice'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123', 'user': 'alice'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2
    assert data['cookies']['session'] == 'abc123'
    assert data['cookies']['user'] == 'alice'

test_cookies_positive_matching_domain_cookies_returned()

tests.name: test_cookies_negative_domain_restricted_cookie_not_included
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A cookie with a Domain attribute that excludes the request host would not be sent by a conforming browser
actions: Import httpbin.core app and create test client
Send GET /cookies with NO Cookie header (simulating browser withholding domain-restricted cookie)
Assert status code is exactly 200
Assert JSON body has key 'cookies' with an empty dict (domain-restricted cookie absent)
expected: JSON body: {"cookies": {}} — domain-restricted cookie is absent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host must NOT appear in /cookies response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_negative_domain_restricted_cookie_not_included():
    client = app.test_client()
    # Simulate: browser withholds cookie with Domain=.other.com (not sent to localhost)
    r = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    # No domain-restricted cookie should appear
    assert data['cookies'] == {}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 0
    # Confirm the key 'restricted_cookie' is absent
    assert 'restricted_cookie' not in data['cookies']

test_cookies_negative_domain_restricted_cookie_not_included()

No cookies are sent in the request (zero cookies — boundary of empty set)
actions: Import httpbin.core app and create test client

trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: boundary — zero cookies sent means zero cookies returned

from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_boundary_empty_cookie_jar():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': ''})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'cookies'}
    assert data['cookies'] == {}
    assert isinstance(data['cookies'], dict)
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 0

tests.name: test_cookies_boundary_one_matching_one_absent_domain_restricted
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
One cookie matches the host; one cookie with mismatched domain is withheld by browser
actions: Send GET /cookies with only the matching-domain cookie (browser withholds the other)
Assert status code == 200
Assert only the matching cookie appears; the domain-restricted one is absent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: only host-matching cookies included; domain-restricted ones excluded
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_boundary_one_matching_one_absent_domain_restricted():
    client = app.test_client()
    # Browser sends only 'good' cookie; 'bad' cookie has Domain=.other.com and is withheld
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'good=yes'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'good': 'yes'}
    assert 'bad' not in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'].get('good') == 'yes'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_cookies_boundary_one_matching_one_absent_domain_restricted()

tests.name: test_cookies_negative_response_structure_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /cookies with no Cookie header
Assert status code is exactly 200 (not 4xx or 5xx)
Assert top-level JSON keys are exactly {'cookies'}
Assert Content-Type header contains application/json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: response must be 2xx with expected payload structure
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_negative_response_structure_exact():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 500
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'cookies'}
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {}

test_cookies_negative_response_structure_exact()
